subject: english
stem: Text: Amy chose the paper map when her phone battery reached zero. Which statement is explicit?
options: Paper maps are better in every situation
Amy forgot to charge the phone on purpose
Amy used a paper map after her phone lost power

optionRationales.reason: Paper maps are better in every situation：一次選擇不能支持 every situation。
Amy forgot to charge the phone on purpose：原因與意圖未提。
The map was free：價格未提。
Amy used a paper map after her phone lost power：battery reached zero 改寫為 phone lost power。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「選項每一部分都能由原文字句直接支持」可推出 Amy used a paper map after her phone lost power；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Amy used a paper map after her phone lost power 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
